answer: Each agent stores a cedar file carrying the challenge hash with a Filecoin provider in 30 minutes and publishes the deal id and checksum. Peers fetch the deal on-chain, confirm active, match the checksum against a mirror copy, and check the onyx timestamp in-window. One honest agent funds 1 deal with 0.01 token collateral for a 150 POA bond, while 10 fakes must fund 10 deals across 10 providers, so costs rise 10X. A missing deal, checksum mismatch, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes offenders.
